description: This file defines a command-line interface (CLI) for managing chat channels and accounts in the openclaw project. It sets up commands like list, status, capabilities, resolve, logs, add, remove, login, and logout, with various options and subcommands, integrating with external modules for command execution.

methods.name: runChannelsCommand
methods.description: Executes a given async action within the runtime context.

methods.name: runChannelsCommandWithDanger
methods.description: Executes a command with error handling that logs and exits on failure.

methods.name: registerChannelsCli
methods.description: Sets up CLI commands for managing chat channels and accounts.
